title: agents2: what changed this week
description: Weekly report for agents2, 4 to 10 October 2026.

fixes.what happened: update wrote -deps locks but the catalog expects -lock, so apply refused to replace them
plannotator was locked as v0.28.10 and stopped matching its npm siblings
undefined compaction fields were written into settings.json

props.content: agents2 builds Pi and the other agent tools on each Mac from one set of profiles. This week it moved from *Pi works* to *Pi runs a team*: long sessions keep their facts, skills reach every runtime, and most fixes were for tools that failed silently.

props.title: Long sessions keep their facts
props.deck: Compaction now uses a cheap model, and memory is saved before anything is summarised.

props.caption: What happens when a session reaches 70% of its context.

items.title: Memory saves first
items.body: OptMem stores durable facts in the background.

items.title: Wake message dropped
items.body: The compaction model removes the memory wake message.

props.summary: Every message between the four parts

props.caption: Facts worth keeping are saved before the summary replaces the old messages.
steps: pi -> mem : save durable facts first
cm -> cm : drop the memory wake message
cm -> haiku : summarise, up to 24K tokens
mem --> pi : wake view with memories

props.title: Three settings behind it
props.deck: Each one is a profile choice, not code.

props.content:
### Compaction model
Each profile picks the model in `pi.settings.compactionModel`. Personal uses Haiku 5.5. The summary limit was raised so Haiku stops falling back to Opus.

### OptMem
Long-term memory is installed and on in both profiles. A single-line memory survives sessions, compactions and model changes.

### Follow-up suggestions
The profile now chooses the model that suggests your next message (`followUpModel`). Personal uses Haiku.

props.title: A team of named agents
props.deck: Pi's built-in agents are off. Seven roles live in the repo, and each profile decides which model runs which role.
props.takeaway: Same team, different models: swap the profile, not the agent files.

props.caption: Agent files never name a model. Apply stops with a clear message if a role has no alias.
edges: spawn -> roles : one lead per worktree

props.content:
- **Roles:** lead, coder, reviewer, oracle, researcher, scribe and qa.
- **Workflows:** saved plan and build scripts. An install script copies them, because Pi's workflow loader ignores symlinks.
- **/spawn-lead:** creates a Herdr workspace with one lead agent in its own git worktree. The lead delegates to coder and reviewer, and reviews run one at a time.

props.title: Skills reach every runtime
props.deck: One catalog feeds Pi and Cursor's cloud agents without copying skills into each repo.

props.caption: The old plan opened PRs to copy skills into every repo. It never ran, so it is gone.

props.content:
**New skills:** `tailnet-expose`, `article-explainer`, `work-inventory`, `spawn-lead` and the latest `frontend-design`, plus usage guides for `agent-browser`.

**Fixed:** the `visual-artifact` skill never loaded because it lived at `skill/`, not `skills/`.
